scope: Attention-only rank-16 LoRA smoke on random 49-frame native subwindows
summary: The 49-frame curriculum substantially reduced normal activation memory and reached late backward computation, but an MLP weight FSDP all-gather still missed a 200 MiB allocation by 37 MiB on both shared GPUs.
evidence: During forward computation selected GPUs showed tens of GiB more headroom than the 93-frame attempt.
The eventual failure occurred during backward unsharding of blocks.34 MLP layer1, requesting 200 MiB with 172 MiB and 163 MiB physically free on ranks 0 and 1.
No checkpoint was produced and result.json records PARTIAL.
lessons: Short-window curriculum is effective, but persistent rank-16 adapter and optimizer state consumes the final narrow margin at late-backward all-gather.
Rank 8 should free more than the observed 37 MiB deficit without dropping attention targets or changing the native video contract.
limitations: No optimizer step completed and no quality evidence was produced.
next_actions: Retry the identical 49-frame attention-only contract at rank 8 in a new directory.
